title: Roadmap (Starting H2 2026)
subtitle: A phased plan focused on validation and coordination learning before expansion.

sections.heading: Guiding Principle
paragraphs: The roadmap prioritizes coordination learning over rapid scaling.
Each phase is designed to validate assumptions before expansion.

sections.heading: H2 2026 — Foundation & Narrative Alignment
paragraphs: Objective: Establish a clear, credible foundation for the platform as a coordination system.
bullets: Finalize platform narrative and positioning
Separate marketing content from legal and compliance documentation
Align website, pitch materials, and internal documentation around a coherent model
Deliver refined website content (vision, how it works, token role)
Publish a dedicated legal documentation hub (disclaimers, policies, disclosures)
Create initial creator onboarding guidelines
Develop internal coordination and valuation framework (experimental)

sections.heading: Q1 2027 — Controlled Alpha & Creator Onboarding
paragraphs: Objective: Test the coordination model with a limited number of real assets.
bullets: Invite a small, curated group of creators
Launch controlled coordination experiments
Observe behavior, friction points, and system dynamics
Release alpha submission and participation flow
Create internal analytics on visibility, engagement, and outcome patterns
Iteratively refine valuation and participation logic

sections.heading: Q2 2027 — Visibility Mechanics & Case Studies
paragraphs: Objective: Translate early experiments into learnings and narratives.
bullets: Improve visibility distribution mechanisms
Document real use cases and outcomes
Publish public case studies (no hype)
Improve promotion and coordination tooling
Create feedback loops between creators and platform
Start early partner conversations

sections.heading: Q3 2027 — Platform Expansion & Partnerships
paragraphs: Objective: Expand cautiously while preserving coordination integrity.
bullets: Broaden creator access (still controlled)
Run partnership pilots with aligned institutions/platforms
Explore B2B coordination use cases
Refine participation and governance mechanics
Track ecosystem health metrics

sections.heading: Q4 2027 — Strategic Review & Scaling Decision
paragraphs: Objective: Decide how (and whether) to scale based on real platform behavior.
bullets: Evaluate experiment performance
Identify strengths, weaknesses, and unintended effects
Decide on scaling, pivoting, or deepening focus
Publish a strategic review document
Update long-term roadmap
Prepare investor and partner briefings

sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: From H2 2026 onward, PonyLife focuses on building a credible coordination framework, validating it through controlled experimentation, and only then considering expansion.
The roadmap emphasizes learning, adaptability, and long-term system health over rapid, speculative growth.
